vocab_words.example: This agreement is legally binding on both parties.
He signed a waiver before joining the tour.
We have a two-hour layover in Singapore.
Submit your receipts for reimbursement by Friday.
Please have your boarding pass ready at the gate.
The flight delay caused him to miss the connection.
The train fare has increased this year.
All passengers must pass through customs.
Please send the invoice to the accounting department.
Revenue increased by ten percent last quarter.

items.question: The manager praised the team for their ___ to the project.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ sau tính từ sở hữu "their".

items.question: This is one of the ___ effective marketing strategies we have used.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh nhất "one of the most + adj".

items.question: If the shipment ___ on time, we will lose the client.
items.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, mệnh đề chính dùng will.

items.question: The proposal ___ by the board before it can be implemented.
items.explanation: Thể bị động với động từ khiếm khuyết: "must be + V3".

items.question: She has been working on this project ___ three months.
items.explanation: "For + khoảng thời gian" (three months) dùng với thì hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn.

items.question: The manager asked her assistant ___ the documents before the meeting.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "ask someone to do something".

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: The consultant recommended ___ the marketing strategy entirely.
items.explanation: "Recommend + V-ing" là cấu trúc đúng khi không có tân ngữ trực tiếp.

items.question: The workshop will be held ___ further notice.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "until further notice" nghĩa là cho đến khi có thông báo mới.

items.question: By the time the CEO arrives, the presentation ___ already finished.
items.explanation: Thì tương lai hoàn thành "will have + V3" diễn tả hành động hoàn tất trước một mốc trong tương lai.
